capabilities: Sync tagged task lines with a PeckList server in both directions
Map Tasks-format fields (due dates, priority, tags, repeats, done) to PeckList tasks
Open, complete, move or delete tasks from an editor menu on synced lines
Filter what syncs with a pre-sync review, folder, note and line exclusions
Sign in with a browser flow or an API key with tasks:read and tasks:write scopes
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The full guide is hosted at pecklist.com/obsidian rather than in the README. The README describes data handling in detail: only tagged task lines leave the device, sent to the single server the user configures, with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian task lines in Tasks format stay in the vault with no way to keep them in sync with an external task server across devices.

relations.evidence: Write a task in the Tasks plugin's format, tag it #pecklist, and it shows up in PeckList.

requires.name: API key with tasks:read and tasks:write

summary: Two-way sync of tagged task lines in Tasks-plugin format with a self-hosted PeckList server, covering titles, dates, priority, tags and repeats.
